pack_name: 墨西哥默认 Market Pack V1

visual_rules.photographic_style: realistic smartphone beauty and lifestyle photo, natural skin texture, no studio catalogue look
hair_constraints: keep hairline, parting, length, curl pattern and color internally consistent within one look
before and after pairs must preserve the same person's facial identity and camera angle
do not blur hair edges or hide the hairline with text
visual_rules.color_grading: warm, lively and natural; preserve accurate hair color across the 5-slide group

copy_rules.fallback_note: unsupported market/language combos must fail loudly, never silently fall back to Thai or generic Spanish
copy_rules.style: short, direct and conversational Mexican Spanish with natural emotional expression and one light interaction prompt

topic_rules.topic_frequency_rule: avoid repeating the same hairstyle choice or occasion within 5 days on one account

safety_rules.face_visibility: face, hairline and full hairstyle silhouette must remain unobscured by overlays
safety_rules.before_after_integrity: do not alter facial identity, skin tone or facial structure to create the transformation
